acceptOwnership().details: The new owner accepts the ownership transfer.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

pendingOwner().details: Returns the address of the pending owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Starts the ownership transfer of the contract to a new account. Replaces the pending transfer if there is one. Can only be called by the current owner. Setting `newOwner` to the zero address is allowed; this can be used to cancel an initiated ownership transfer.

DEFAULT_CHARITY_BPS().notice: Default charity rate: 2.5% of gross Musharakah profit.         Must be confirmed by the board (SR-002) before live use.

MAX_CHARITY_BPS().notice: Hard cap on the charity rate — cannot exceed 5% of gross profit.         Requires a contract upgrade to raise. Protects depositor principal.

boardRegistry().notice: Optional Shariah registry for single-source board membership (I4).         When set, board-gated functions check registry.isBoard(msg.sender).         When address(0), only the owner can call those functions.

charityBps().notice: Current charity rate in basis points (default 250 = 2.5%).

charityWallet().notice: Active charity wallet. Must be a board-approved address (SR-003).

escrow().notice: PurificationEscrow address.  Set after escrow deploy via setEscrow().         distributeCharity() accepts calls from either vault or escrow so that         the waterfall path (vault → escrow → charityModule) works correctly.

setEscrow(address).notice: Wire the PurificationEscrow after it is deployed.         Must be called once by the owner before any profit claim.         The escrow calls distributeCharity() as part of executeWaterfall().

totalCharityDistributed().notice: Lifetime USDC distributed to the charity wallet.

      An owner who is also the initialBoardMember of the registry may call.
      Renamed from onlyBoardOrOwner to onlyBoard (K2) since boardRegistry is mandatory
      and an owner who is not on the board is blocked regardless.

@title  CharityModule
 @notice Routes a configurable percentage of Shariah vault profit to a board-approved
         charity wallet (sadaqah) before the Musharakah profit split.
 @dev    Replaces the fixed-rate ZakatModule (now @deprecated) with:
           - A board-settable `charityBps` (default 250 = 2.5%, hard cap 500 = 5%)
           - 30-day timelock on both the charity wallet and the rate
           - Separate `totalCharityDistributed` counter (does NOT add to ZakatModule's counter)
         Terminology: "Zakat" is a specific religious obligation with precise
         nisab and haul rules. This module distributes voluntary sadaqah.
         The word "Zakat" MUST NOT appear in any user-facing string without a
         board pronouncement per AGENTS.md rule on terminology.
         Board rulings required before live use: SR-002 (rate), SR-003 (wallet).
